data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Pass-log format clarification — pass records are stored as per-pass JSON files at bridge_state/snapshots/<pass_id>.pass_record.json (NOT an aggregated log). audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py reads ALL pass_record.json files in bridge_state/snapshots/, correlates by pass_id naming convention (pass_id format: phase=<phase_name>_n=<pass_number>_ts=<timestamp> or equivalent — confirm with applier.py canonical form), determines pass_number from filename or from {phase, n} fields in the JSON, applies cap (10 for phase=bootstrap-strict n=1..5, 100 for phase=bootstrap-throttle n=1..3). CLI: audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py --pass-log-dir <path-to-bridge_state/snapshots/> --phase <phase>. Cross-language coupling justification (subprocess CLI for gate): the phase-gate is sourced by 4 bash callers (audit_dd1, dd2, dd5 + Makefile); replicating gate logic in Python would create drift risk between the 5 callers. Subprocess CLI maintains single source of truth. Add AC: check audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh is executable before subprocess invocation; fail with clear diagnostic otherwise.
